comparator.name: Pedagogical Sciences (ALPO pathway)
comparator.sourceNotes: 2026–2027 OER Appendix 5 establishes the Radboud BSc within ALPO:120 EC of university courses over four years (34+31+25+30), plus 60 EC exemption grounded in the parallel HAN Pabo curriculum. This is not the combined 240 EC workload or the separate 240 EC Pabo diploma. Onderwijs selects Kwaliteit van onderwijs and Vormgeven van onderwijs (4 EC each), followed by Beroepsvaardigheden 3 onderwijs en pedagogiek (8 EC). Appendix5fullyspecifies the ALPO allocation; no additional unallocated elective space is invented. The general regular-degree elective rules are not substituted for this tailored programme. Appendix 5 visibly repeats PWB 3370 Samenwerken met professionals twice; it is one identical 4 EC code, counted once, consistent with the stated 30 EC fourth-year total and current official year 4 list. Art 8.2 requires academic-skills 1 before 2, professional-skillsALPO before 3 and academic-skills 2 before the thesis; pre-enrolment also applies to thesis and professional-skills 3. Complete earlier-year requirements in this ordinary pathway. Appendix 6 requires 24 of 34 RU EC in year 1 for a positive RU BSA; HAN currently describes its own advice as nonbinding PSA, so no second binding threshold is asserted. RADAr academic Dutch is a 0 EC year 1 obligation on the current year page and is recorded separately rather than added to the 180 EC. Teaching is Dutch and the combined pathway is full-time. The ordinary pathway completes each preceding RU and HAN year and the stated academic/preregistration gates; its recognised exemption rests on completion of the parallel teacher-education curriculum. Names are faithful English display translations; original Dutch names survive in the preserved research.

alternatives.concept: A programme studying typical and atypical human development through developmental, social and clinical psychology, cognition and language, supported by biological foundations, philosophy of mind, social institutions, ethical reasoning and empirical research. Applied rhetoric with primary-school pupils and youth-focused educational research connect part of this study to learning environments.

comparatorRouteSelection.basis: The generic ALPO bachelor combines pedagogical science with primary teaching. Onderwijs most directly represents this defining identity through educational quality and curriculum design. It is selected independently of UCR fit; the formal source confirms all four specialisations and the corresponding professional-skills choices.

progressionAssessment.rationale: All formal prerequisites and current offerings checked directly. Brain-and-behaviour precedes dependent psychology/cognition, general methods precedes the experimental-statistics course and evidence synthesis, the life-science gateway precedes physiology, and rhetoric precedes applied school teaching. Psycholinguistics uses its only covered offering in semester2; it has no requirement for a prior dedicated language course. PPD is in Year1.

alternativeSelection.assessment: Stop at one. The strongest developmental-support content is now included in the closest programme: lifespan and abnormal psychology, clinical assessment and therapy perspectives, language, youth resilience and empirical methods. The old second programme achieved difference mainly through evolution, cellular biology, molecular pathology, laboratory work, infection, immunity and organ disease. Those subjects do not implement a distinct orthopedagogical or learning-support curriculum. No credible separate 24-course developmental-support programme can be formed by padding this limited content; simple removal or reshuffling would not establish qualitative distinctness. Educational quality and curriculum design remains a genuine but infeasible further direction because dedicated educational evaluation, curriculum and didactics courses are absent.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Partial correspondence in higher cognition and brain–behaviour research; UCR does not reproduce a dedicated clinical/developmental neuropsychology syllabus.
Both examine links between cognition and language; UCR provides an advanced psycholinguistic treatment rather than the comparator's developmental course.
Partial developmental correspondence: childhood and adolescent social/emotional development within a lifespan course; not a dedicated moral-development course.
Related developmental psychology is present, but there is no separate course centred on pedagogy and theories of upbringing.
No selected course centres on educational science as a field, including the organisation and study of education.
Language and developmental difficulties occur in selected courses, but there is no separate course centred on educational learning difficulties.
Perception and action are studied at UCR, but the selected course does not establish a dedicated sequence in children’s motor and perceptual development.
Partial correspondence in psychopathology and assessment: UCR studies disorders across the lifespan rather than providing a dedicated child-and-adolescent course.

Partial correspondence through psychological-test reliability, validity, appraisal and introductory administration. UCR places these within clinical assessment and psychotherapy rather than a complete measurement and decision-theory course.
Clinical assessment and developmental psychology offer related perspectives, but no selected course introduces the pedagogical framework of special-needs support.
Atypical development is addressed within lifespan and clinical psychology; those courses occupy their stronger counterpart rows, without a second separate developmental-difficulties course.
Both introduce research design, measurement and statistical reasoning for empirical inquiry.
UCR includes general and psychological statistics, but no separate four-course Analyse sequence corresponding component by component.
UCR's quantitative methods are represented by Research Methods & Statistics and Statistics & Experimental Methods; there is no second directly equivalent component.
UCR does not reproduce the comparator's third sequenced analysis course as a separate required component.
UCR does not reproduce the comparator's fourth sequenced analysis course as a separate required component.
Required 10 EC ALPO bachelor thesis. The scheduled UCR seminar teaches evidence synthesis; optional independent research is separate from the 24-course programme.

UCR’s age-appropriate lesson and material design addresses part of educational design. It concentrates on rhetoric with partner primary schools, rather than general curriculum development and didactics.
Philosophy of mind and ethics address different philosophical questions; neither centres on the philosophy of science.
UCR has communication and professional-development courses but no ALPO professional-practice sequence combining pedagogical science and teacher education.
Research training is distributed across several UCR courses; no additional course supplies this second dedicated pedagogical-science academic-skills component.
UCR offers social-science analysis of institutions but no dedicated course in evaluating educational quality.
There is no selected course centred on collaboration among educational and child-support professionals.
UCR has no advanced professional-practice component equivalent to the ALPO education-and-pedagogy route.
General rhetoric and academic communication support study but are not the dedicated pedagogical-science academic-skills component.
General moral philosophy supports ethical reflection, but no selected course provides the combined legal and professional-ethical context of working with children.

This is a 60-EC recognition within the Radboud degree, based on the parallel teacher-education curriculum. No single UCR course represents that curriculum or its sustained placements and subject didactics.

notes.text: This UCR programme offers substantial developmental psychology, cognition, language and research, with specific work involving primary pupils and youth learning environments. ALPO also provides dedicated pedagogy, education science, curriculum design, sustained professional practice and subject didactics through the linked Pabo. UCR does not reproduce that teaching curriculum or award its professional qualification. Its evidence-synthesis seminar is not the required ALPO bachelor thesis.

audience.programmeDescription: ALPO combines Radboud’s Pedagogical Sciences degree with primary-teacher education at HAN over four years. Students study typical and atypical child development, upbringing, learning and research, alongside subject didactics and school practice.
audience.comparisonExplanation: One UCR programme offers a related academic route through developmental psychology, cognition, language and research, with limited direct school engagement. It provides less dedicated pedagogy, education science and professional practice than ALPO, and does not qualify students as primary-school teachers.

curriculum.limitation: The Radboud degree contains 120 EC of university courses over four years plus a 60-EC exemption based on the parallel HAN primary-teacher programme. This table represents that 180-EC degree, not the combined workload of both degrees. Teaching is in Dutch; zero-credit RADAr academic Dutch is also required.
